{{Quote|Just because it's closer to your weight class doesn't mean it'll be any easier to take down.|Bounty hunter Ro-San Borokki on gohai|<ref name="BHC" />}}
'''Gohai''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Limb/Legends|quadruped]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that could be found throughout the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. With a well-muscled body comparable in size to large predators like the [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]] or [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]], they had a long, thick tail. Their faces had two [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], a flat [[Nose/Legends|nose]], pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]], and a single wide [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] filled with sharp pointed [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. The jaw also had a distinctly triangular-shaped pair of mandibles with their narrowest point jutting toward the creature's anterior. Gohai had a narrow waist, digitigrade limbs and the robust torso came to a peak between the shoulder blades.<ref name="BHC" />

The ''[[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]]'' recommended that if they charged at a being, the target should drop to the ground. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Ro-San Borokki]] mentioned gohai when she wrote "The Hunt," a chapter of the ''Bounty Hunters' Guild Handbook.''<ref name="BHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The gohai were first seen in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', which was released in [[October]] [[2013]] and written by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Ryder Windham]], and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="BHC" />
